targets.query: from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: -5m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "factory_plc_oee_metrics" and r._field == "Predictive_Maintenance_Alert") |> last()

targets.rawSql: SELECT asset_name, alert_level, metric_name, metric_value, triggered_at FROM factory.maintenance_alerts WHERE acknowledged_at IS NULL ORDER BY triggered_at DESC
SELECT asset_name, COUNT(*) AS alert_count FROM factory.maintenance_alerts WHERE triggered_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' GROUP BY asset_name ORDER BY alert_count DESC

targets.query: from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "factory_plc_conveyor_status" and r._field == "vibration_rms")

panels.title: Robot Cycle Time Drift

targets.query: from(bucket: "telemetry") |> range(start: -24h) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "factory_plc_conveyor_status" and r._field == "Machine_Cycle_Time")

panels.description: A gradual upward trend indicates mechanical wear; sustained deviation beyond baseline triggers a predictive maintenance alert.

panels.title: Downtime Events Linked to Fault Codes (7d)

targets.rawSql: SELECT started_at, fault_code, fault_description, duration_seconds, resolved_by FROM factory.downtime_events WHERE started_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' ORDER BY started_at DESC
